definitions.gloss: full name, surname and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name including family name and personal name.

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in your full name.

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my fortune told based on my name.
examples.notes: {姓名|せいめい}{判断|はんだん} = fortune telling by name

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me how to read your full name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{姓名|せいめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your full name and address correctly on the application form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{姓名|せいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦とは→と：00512_to⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, the order of the full name is the reverse of the West, with the surname coming first.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧ - surname, family name
- ⟦{名|めい}→名：03496_na⟧ - given name, first name

JAPANESE NAME ORDER:
In Japanese, the family name (⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧) comes first, followed by the given name (⟦{名|めい}→名：03496_na⟧). This is the opposite of Western name order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姓名|せいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write one's full name)
- {姓名|せいめい}⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (name-based fortune telling)
- {姓名|せいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧ (entering full name on forms)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧ - statement, declaration
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧ - life
